whatWasLearned.headline: The simple baseline given a train-residual distribution fixes the POINT forecast (beats the simulation chain by 10 yds MAE on identical points) and the INTERVALS (coverage 0.809, first pass-yds candidate ever inside the band) — but its THRESHOLD probabilities stay badly calibrated (0.113; the champion chain's on the same population is worse, 0.163).
whatWasLearned.structure: Two pooled residual buckets are too coarse for probability claims: starter pool n=939 with an asymmetric band (p10 -91 / p90 +120), contested pool only n=209, and the share gate empties the reserve bucket. A single pooled CDF cannot price lines that sit at each player's own recent mean.
whatWasLearned.namedNextDependency: A share-continuous predictive spread — residual scale modeled as a train-fit function of walk-forward share and recent volatility (or a per-player conditional sigma) — replacing the pooled-bucket CDF. Requires its own preregistration; nothing here may be tuned against 2025 again.
whatWasLearned.familyStanding: player_pass_yds stays WITHHELD. No engine — simulation chain or baseline — currently clears calibration on the honest population; the boards keep saying so with the exact bar.
